recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast composition featuring a vertical split between a stark white negative space and a warm-toned photographic scene. The layout uses bold, overlapping typography to bridge the two halves, creating a sense of dynamic movement and personality.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical division between flat white and warm photographic depth
Bold red title overlapping the central vertical boundary
Subject in dark attire contrasting against a light, repetitive background
Large, light-colored header text anchoring the top-left corner

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Main subject occupies the right two-thirds, standing in a confident pose with a slight lean.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large red title in the lower-left quadrant acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top-left header, move down to the red title, then follow the subject's pose into the photographic depth.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The left third is dominated by pure white space, providing breathing room for secondary metadata.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pure white for the left-side background and negative space.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black and warm beige within the photographic scene.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red for the primary title and subject's footwear.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white background and dark subject; high saturation in the red accents.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to white, black, warm beige, and primary red.

letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses extra-bold, tightly tracked sans-serif
Secondary header uses wide, outlined or low-contrast sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Tightly kerned letters in the main title to create a solid block of color
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold geometric sans-serif for impact paired with delicate transitional serifs for information.

preserve: The red color of the main title
The tight tracking of the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and impact of the primary title.
Provides the necessary classical serif contrast for metadata.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a vertical split-screen image. The left 35% is solid white. The right 65% is a warm-toned photograph of a person in a dark habit and red heels, leaning against a wall, with a line of similar figures receding into the background in soft focus.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a large, wide, outlined sans-serif name at the top left. Place a massive, two-line, bold red sans-serif title in the lower-left, overlapping the photo edge. Add small serif metadata in the white space and at the bottom right.

verificationChecks: Is the red title overlapping the photo boundary?
Is the left side pure white?
Are the red shoes visible and matching the title color?
Is the hierarchy clear between the three font styles?

adjustableVariables: Width of the white vertical section
Weight of the top-left header text
postGenerationChecks: Check for clean text outlines on the top header
Ensure the red title is the most prominent element
Verify the warm color temperature of the photographic side
Confirm the serif text is small but legible
recipe.reuseFormula: Split-screen layout + Bold overlapping sans-serif + Delicate serif metadata + High-contrast subject
